name: Starbound
author: aetheris-project
description: Starbound dedicated server: space exploration sandbox with planets, colonies and mods.

installation.script:
# @author Aetheris Project
# @description Starbound dedicated server install via SteamCMD
# @user-alpine

apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y curl tar

mkdir -p /home/container/steamcmd
cd /home/container

curl -sSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update 211820 validate +quit
chmod +x /home/container/linux64/starbound_server 2>/dev/null || true

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password required to join (leave empty for a public server).
